title: How to track the stabilizer circuit with noise?
---

**Links:** https://link.aps.org/doi/10.1103/PhysRevA.107.032424

## Abstract 
This paper presents a method for tracking Pauli noise plus Clifford operations:

1. Using the graph state representation of stabilizer states/stabilizer simulation based on graph states
2. Shifting all encountered Pauli noise forward and updating it, ultimately transforming it into applying a complex Pauli-$Z$ noise on a known stabilizer state.
